can_do.en: I can ask for and understand simple directions.
can_do.zh: 我能询问并听懂简单的路线指引。

scene.en: A street in central Kraków; you bump into Marek and ask the way to the main train station.
scene.zh: 在波兰克拉科夫市中心的一条街上，你偶遇了邻居马雷克（Marek），向他询问去中央火车站怎么走。

mission.en: Ask the way to the station
Ask if it is far
Thank him

complication.en: He describes a shortcut through the park too fast; ask him to repeat it slowly.
complication.zh: 他语速太快地解释穿过公园的捷径；请他慢点再说一遍。

opener.en: Oh, hello! What are you doing here?

closer.en: You're welcome. Have a good day!
closer.zh: 不客气，祝你今天顺心，再见！

phrases.en: How do I get to the station?
phrases.zh: 请问去火车站该怎么走？

phrases.en: Go straight on, then turn left.
Could you say that more slowly, please?

grammar_focus.en: Asking for directions: 'Where is...?' and 'How do I get to...?'
grammar_focus.zh: 问路句型：用“Where is...?”（…在哪儿？）或“How do I get to...?”（去…怎么走？）直接礼貌询问地点和路线。

title.zh: 买一张去华沙的火车票

can_do.en: I can buy a train ticket and understand departure times and platforms.
can_do.zh: 我能购买火车票，并听懂发车时间和站台信息。

scene.en: The ticket office at Kraków Główny railway station.
scene.zh: 在克拉科夫中央火车站（Kraków Główny）的售票窗口前。

mission.en: Ask for a ticket to Warsaw: single or return
mission.zh: 买一张去华沙的车票，说明是单程还是往返

mission.en: Choose a departure time
Ask which platform it leaves from

complication.en: The 10:00 train is full; take a later one.
complication.zh: 上午10点的车次满员了，需要改选稍晚的车次。

closer.en: Platform three. Have a good journey!
closer.zh: 在三站台，祝您旅途愉快！

phrases.zh: 请给我一张去华沙的票。

grammar_focus.en: Polite requests with '... please' and choosing options with 'or'
grammar_focus.zh: 简短礼貌表达与二选一：名词后加“please”（如“A ticket to Warsaw, please”），以及用“or”连接选项（如“One-way or return?”）。

can_do.en: I can say where I want to go and ask about the time and price.
can_do.zh: 我能告诉司机目的地，并询问所需时间和车费。

scene.en: In a taxi from the airport; Zbyszek is driving.
scene.zh: 在从机场开往市区的出租车上，兹比谢克（Zbyszek）正在开车。

mission.en: Say where you are going
Ask how long the ride takes
Ask for the price and pay

complication.en: There is a traffic jam; he asks if a longer route is okay.
complication.zh: 路上堵车，司机询问是否可以改走稍远但畅通的路线。

opener.en: Good afternoon. Where are we going?

first_question.en: To the centre? What is the address?
first_question.zh: 去市中心吗？具体地址是哪儿？

closer.en: Here we are. Enjoy your stay!
closer.zh: 到了！祝你在克拉科夫玩得开心！

phrases.zh: 请去“玫瑰之下”酒店（Hotel Pod Różą，克拉科夫著名老牌酒店）。

grammar_focus.en: Asking about duration and cost: 'How long...?' and 'How much...?'
grammar_focus.zh: 疑问句“How long...?”与“How much...?”：分别用来询问耗时（多久）和费用（多少钱）。

can_do.en: I can say where I am and when I will arrive.
can_do.zh: 我能描述自己目前的位置，并告知对方何时到达。

scene.en: Kasia is waiting for you at a café, but you are lost; she calls you.
scene.zh: 卡夏（Kasia）在咖啡馆等你，但你迷路了，她给你打来了电话。

mission.en: Say where you are and what you can see
mission.zh: 说明你在哪里以及周围能看到什么

mission.en: Follow her directions
Say when you will get there
mission.zh: 说明你大概几分钟后能到

complication.en: You realise you took the wrong tram.
complication.zh: 你发现自己坐错了有轨电车。

first_question.en: What can you see? Is there a shop or a stop?
first_question.zh: 你周围能看到什么？有商店或者车站吗？

closer.en: OK, I'm waiting! See you in a bit.

phrases.en: I can see a church and a park.
phrases.zh: 我能看到一座教堂和一个公园。

phrases.en: I think I'm on the wrong tram.
I'll be there in ten minutes.

grammar_focus.en: Perception with 'can see' and future arrival with 'I'll be there in...'
grammar_focus.zh: 视觉描述与将来到达时间：用“I can see + 名词”（我能看见…）描述周围标志，用“I'll be there in + 时间”（我…之后到）表达预计到达时刻。

can_do.en: I can ask about a flat and say what I think of it.
can_do.zh: 我能询问房屋的基本情况，并表达对房子的看法。

scene.en: Viewing a small flat that Basia rents out.
scene.zh: 在克拉科夫看房，房东巴夏（Basia）正在带你参观她出租的一套小公寓。

mission.en: Ask how many rooms there are
Ask about the rent and bills
mission.zh: 询问租金及水电杂费是否包含在内

mission.en: Say what you like or don't like
mission.zh: 表达你满意或不满意的地方

complication.en: The washing machine doesn't work; ask when it will be fixed.
complication.zh: 洗衣机坏了，询问房东什么时候能修好。

first_question.en: This is the living room. Nice, isn't it?
first_question.zh: 这是客厅，挺不错的对吧？

closer.en: Have a think and give me a call. Goodbye!
closer.zh: 你好好考虑考虑，之后给我打电话。再见！

phrases.en: How much is it per month?

phrases.zh: 水电杂费都包含在内吗？

grammar_focus.en: 'How many + plural noun + are there?' for asking about quantities
grammar_focus.zh: 提问数量：“How many + 可数名词复数 + are there?”（有几个/多少…？），常用于看房时询问房间或设施数量。

can_do.en: I can describe a room and say what is missing.
can_do.zh: 我能描述房间里的摆设，并说出还缺少什么家具。

scene.en: A video call; Kasia wants to see your new room.
scene.zh: 在视频通话中，卡夏（Kasia）想看看你在克拉科夫租的新房间。

mission.en: Describe three things in your room
mission.zh: 描述房间里的三样东西

mission.en: Say what is missing
mission.zh: 说出房间里还缺少什么

mission.en: Ask about her room
mission.zh: 询问她的房间是什么样的

complication.en: She says your room looks empty; say what you want to buy.
complication.zh: 她说你的房间看起来有点空，告诉她你想买些什么东西。

first_question.en: Have you got a big bed?
first_question.zh: 你房间里有一张大床吗？

closer.zh: 房间很棒！好啦，先挂啦，拜拜！

phrases.en: There's a desk and a chair.
phrases.zh: 这里有一张书桌和一把椅子。

phrases.en: I want to buy a lamp.
My room is small but nice.
phrases.zh: 我的房间虽小，但挺温馨的。

grammar_focus.en: 'There is / There's + singular noun' and 'I don't have + noun'
grammar_focus.zh: 房间陈设与物品拥有：用“There's a...”（有一个…）表示房间里存在某物，用“I don't have a...”（我没有…）说明缺少某物。

can_do.en: I can talk about my daily routine and times.
can_do.zh: 我能谈论自己的日常作息并约定时间。

scene.en: Tomek wants to go running with you and asks about your routine.
scene.zh: 托梅克（Tomek）想和你一起晨跑，正在询问你的日常作息习惯。

mission.en: Say what time you get up
Say what you do in the morning
mission.zh: 说明你早晨通常做些什么

mission.en: Agree on a time to run

complication.en: He wants to run at six; suggest a later time.
complication.zh: 他想早上6点去跑，但对你太早了，建议一个稍晚的时间。

opener.en: Hi! Are we running tomorrow morning?
opener.zh: 嗨！咱们明早一起去跑步吗？

first_question.en: What time do you get up?

phrases.en: In the morning I have a coffee.
phrases.zh: 早晨我通常先喝杯咖啡。

phrases.en: I go to work at nine.

grammar_focus.en: Present simple for routines and time preposition 'at': 'I get up at seven'
grammar_focus.zh: 一般现在时谈论日常习惯与时间介词“at”：描述规律作息时，具体钟点前使用介词“at”（如“at seven”）。

can_do.en: I can explain a problem at home and ask for advice.
can_do.zh: 我能描述家里的维修故障并向他人寻求建议。

scene.en: There is no hot water in your flat, so you knock on Marek's door.
scene.zh: 你住的公寓没有热水了，于是你去敲邻居马雷克（Marek）的房门求助。

mission.en: Explain the problem
Ask what to do or who to call
mission.zh: 询问该怎么做或者该联系谁

mission.en: Thank him

complication.en: He says it is the whole building; you need to call the building management.
complication.zh: 他说整栋楼都没热水，你需要给公寓物业管理处打电话报修。

first_question.zh: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

closer.en: Call the building management. Good luck!
closer.zh: 直接给物业管理处打电话就行。祝你顺利！

phrases.zh: 有东西坏了/不能正常使用了。

grammar_focus.en: Asking for advice with modal verb 'should': 'What should I do?'
grammar_focus.zh: 用情态动词“should”询问建议：“What should I do?”（我该怎么办？）和“Who should I call?”（我该联系谁？）。

can_do.en: I can arrange a day, time, and place to meet.
can_do.zh: 我能和朋友商定见面的日期、时间和地点。

scene.en: Planning to go to the cinema with Kasia this week.
scene.zh: 这周打算和卡夏（Kasia）一起去电影院看电影，正在商量安排。

mission.en: Suggest a day
Agree on a time
Decide where to meet

complication.en: She is busy on the day you suggest; choose another day.
complication.zh: 你提议的那天她有事，需要改选其他日子。

opener.en: Hey! Shall we go to the cinema this week?
opener.zh: 嗨！这周咱们一起去电影院看电影好吗？

closer.en: Great, see you at the cinema!
closer.zh: 太好了，那咱们电影院见！

phrases.en: I can't make it on Saturday.
Let's meet in front of the cinema.
phrases.zh: 我们在电影院门口见吧。

grammar_focus.en: Preposition 'on' for days of the week: 'on Friday', 'on Saturday'
grammar_focus.zh: 星期前的时间介词“on”：在具体的星期几前面要用介词“on”（如“on Friday”、“on Saturday”）。

can_do.en: I can talk about weekend plans and accept or decline an invitation.
can_do.zh: 我能谈论周末计划，并能礼貌接受或婉拒邀请。

scene.en: Tomek invites you to the mountains near Zakopane this weekend.
scene.zh: 托梅克（Tomek）邀请你周末去波兰著名的度假滑雪小镇扎科帕内（Zakopane）附近的山里爬山。

mission.en: Say what you usually do at weekends
mission.zh: 说说你平时周末一般怎么过

mission.en: Say if you can come
Ask what to bring

complication.en: The forecast says rain; suggest something else instead.
complication.zh: 天气预报说要下雨，建议改去别的室内活动。

opener.en: Hi! Shall we go to the mountains on Saturday?
opener.zh: 嗨！这周六一起去山里徒步怎么样？

first_question.en: What do you usually do at weekends?
first_question.zh: 你平时周末一般都做些什么？

closer.en: OK, I'll text you the details. See you!
closer.zh: 好，我发短信把具体安排发你。回头见！

phrases.zh: 周末我通常就在家休息。

grammar_focus.en: Weather prediction with 'going to': 'It's going to rain'
grammar_focus.zh: 用“be going to”预测天气：“It's going to rain”（要下雨了），用于根据当前迹象或预报对即将来临的情况作推测。

can_do.en: I can book a doctor's appointment by phone.
can_do.zh: 我能通过电话预约医生门诊。

scene.en: A phone call to the Zdrowie clinic to book an appointment.
scene.zh: 给克拉科夫的“健康”（Zdrowie）社区诊所打电话，预约全科医生门诊。

mission.en: Say you want an appointment
mission.zh: 说明你想预约医生看诊

mission.en: Agree on a day and time
Give your name

complication.en: The doctor is only free next week; ask if there is anything earlier.
complication.zh: 医生本周都满了，只有下周的号；询问有没有更早一点的时间。

closer.zh: 已经为您登记预约好了。再见！

phrases.en: I'd like to make an appointment, please.

phrases.zh: 请问有更早一点的时间吗？

grammar_focus.en: Polite requests with 'I'd like to + verb': 'I'd like to make an appointment'
grammar_focus.zh: 礼貌提出需求：“I'd like to + 动词原形”（我想…），在预约挂号、办事时比“I want to...”更加客气得体。

can_do.en: I can accept an invitation and ask for details.
can_do.zh: 我能接受邀请并询问活动细节。

scene.en: Ania invites you to her birthday party.
scene.zh: 你的团队主管安妮亚（Ania）邀请你参加她的生日聚会。

mission.en: Accept the invitation
Ask when and where it is
mission.zh: 询问聚会的时间和地点

mission.en: Ask what to bring

complication.en: It clashes with another plan; ask if you can come later.
complication.zh: 聚会时间和你的另一项安排冲突了；询问能否晚一点到场。

opener.en: Listen, it's my birthday on Saturday!
opener.zh: 跟你说个事，这周六是我的生日！

phrases.zh: 我需要带点什么东西去吗？

grammar_focus.en: Asking for permission with 'Can I + verb?': 'Can I come later?'
grammar_focus.zh: 用“Can I + 动词原形...?”礼貌请求许可：“Can I come later?”（我可以晚点到吗？）。
